scope.mode: read-only audit of original artifacts; only review.json and verified_facts.json created

checks.name: conditions_and_manifest
checks.detail: Configs match protocol conditions. Both stages use the same 16 train, 8 validation and 16 test mazes, reward-v1, seeds 0/1/2, no action mask; manifest hash and per-maze hashes are consistent. MLP14 changes input_size 10→14 with fresh seeds; parameter counts 5124/5380.

checks.name: stored_validation_trace_integrity
checks.detail: Independently reconstructed all 48 final validation episodes from stored maze, position and action records. All action transitions, collision flags, rewards, float32 observations (including MLP14 visited bits), episode counts, success/collision/failure-type metrics, mean success steps and success-only path efficiencies matched within 1e-6. Failure classification and MLP14 threshold used exactly the last 9 positions (8 moves).

checks.name: mlp14_entry_gate
checks.detail: MLP10 final validation: 24 episodes; two-cell oscillation failures using the predefined 8-move tail = seed 0: 8, seed 1: 7, seed 2: 5, total 20. Both ≥6 total and ≥2 seeds thresholds pass; all three MLP10 seeds completed before MLP14.

checks.name: metrics_and_checkpoint_selection
checks.detail: Recomputed each final validation summary; primary checkpoint is latest.pt at 20,000, while reported intermediate best checkpoints remain secondary. Exploration training returns, final train-pool greedy and validation greedy remain separate. Final test unused.

checks.name: budget_and_execution
checks.detail: Six seeds completed; each used 20,000 env steps, 4,985 optimizer updates and 159,520 sampled replay items. Ledger totals 120,000/120,000 steps, 518.516 elapsed seconds/3,600 second cap, one CUDA worker, zero retries. Device metadata names NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060.

checks.name: checkpoint_restore_and_independent_inference
checks.detail: This reviewer could not execute Python/PyTorch in the isolated process. The separate checkpoint_restore_audit.json supplies an independent CPU reconstruction and PyTorch restore for all six latest.pt checkpoints. Its checkpoint SHA-256 values match the files; all 48 final validation episodes match stored actions, paths, rewards and collision flags exactly and observations within 1e-7. Every checkpoint is step 20,000 with input size 10 or 14 as specified. The independently recorded MLP10 eight-move oscillation count is 20 (8/7/5).

limitations: This is a fixed eight-maze development validation set across three policy seeds, not final held-out test performance. Final test was not used.
Three policy seeds and 24 evaluations per stage do not support broad maze-distribution or causal claims.
Training return includes epsilon exploration and differs from greedy training/validation success.
Path efficiency is conditional on successful validation episodes.
CNN results differ in both observation scope and model architecture and are reference-only.

This reviewer could not personally execute PyTorch due to its isolated process environment; the checkpoint restoration and replay were independently completed in the separate checkpoint_restore_audit.json.
approval_scope: Approved for accurately qualified development-result reporting and local content preparation only; not final held-out test performance or causal evidence.
